hints.title: Operator Precedence
hints.text: Multiplication holds higher precedence than addition and subtraction and must be resolved first.

hints.title: Dual Stacks
hints.text: Maintain separate collections for numerical operands and pending operators.

hints.title: Parenthetical Unwinding
hints.text: Upon meeting a closing parenthesis, evaluate operators until matching opening parenthesis is cleared.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: length of expression string s
complexity.notes: Classic shunting-yard two-stack expression evaluation in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive evaluation without precedence tracking leads to misordered arithmetic operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for value and operator stacks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement standard Dijkstra shunting yard or dual-stack expression evaluator.
